Value Proposition:

The Water Charity supports monumental changes to third world countries that lack fresh water distributions towards its people. We communicate with experts, community leaders, and activists to find the best solutions to tackle these problems the best way and in a way we can provide to all we can.

Our Story

Real Impact: Meet Amina

Amina used to walk miles every day to collect water for her family. Thanks to your support, her village now has a clean water well. Amina can go to school and her family is healthier and happier.
